purpose: Prosecutor questions for any organ claiming maturity under the six gate canon.

questions: Does the organ identify itself consistently?
Does its jurisdiction match its files and claimed functions?
Does it explicitly state what it does not govern?
Does every capability claim map to an evidence path?
Are not-claimed and forbidden claims explicit?
Can the organ be invoked safely?
Can the operator see what happened?
Are recommendations based on scoring and evidence?
Does Red Team exist and accuse the organ?
Does Blue Team harden without suppressing accusations?
Is Custodes pass separate from organ self-validation?
Is Throne pass separate from Custodes pass?
Is local crown prevented from becoming global assembled?
blocking_findings: local crown stolen into global readiness

questions: Does the organ feed stage score without corrupting global truth?
Can it regress and be revalidated?
Can app/game projection render it without becoming source of truth?
